jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs.description: Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders. Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast. Junior Data Scientist Berlin, On-site Most Junior Data Scientists spend their first years building dashboards and reporting on what already happened. Here, you'll work on models that run in production and shape what millions of users see every day. You'll join a small team of people who have built and shipped ML systems at scale, and learn from them directly. You get real problems from week one, and the support to solve them. Show us you can own more, and we'll give you more. What You'll Do 🎯 Build models that predict user value, engagement and reward behaviour, and see them live in our product Run A/B tests on offers, rewards and ranking, and work out what actually caused the result Build and fix the data pipelines your models depend on Take on new problems with no playbook yet, from first idea to production What You'll Bring 💡 Strong Python and SQL. You use AI tools to move faster, and you still check the output You get going on a vague problem without waiting for a spec, and you take it further than you were asked You quickly see which number matters and which question to answer first Proof that you aim high: a project, result or choice where you went past "good enough" when nobody asked you to Bonus: a strong result in a Kaggle challenge, hackathon or competition, or a system you built and fixed yourself when it broke Why Almedia A small, selective team of very sharp people. We keep it small on purpose, so every hire raises the bar Equity in Almedia. Every Berlin-based employee gets a stake, so you share in what you help build Top-of-market pay as the baseline. Outlier impact gets paid accordingly Small team, high bar. If that sounds like home, apply. We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill

jobs.title: Experienced Machine Learning Engineer - Spain 🇪🇸 (Spanish speaking)
jobs.description: Our Mission ⚖️ At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform. Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard. Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform. Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that. Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities. Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting. And we're just getting started. The context Following rapid and profitable growth in France, Doctrine has expanded to Italy and Germany, then acquired Maïté, a Spanish legaltech company, at the start of 2026. We are now looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to keep improving our legal AI for the Spanish market. You will work on models and pipelines that process Spanish legal documents, and your work will directly shape the product roadmap for Spain. Please note: the position is based in Paris, in our offices in the 18th arrondissement. You can find details about our full stack on GitHub . Good to know: prior professional experience in the legal field is not required. However, being eager to commit and build expertise in understanding legal documents is essential. Missions 🛠 Develop NLP models (machine learning–based or otherwise) to support information search and recommendation within legal documents, with a particular focus on the Spanish language. Maintain and monitor these models in production. Design conversational agents to help lawyers across different legal domains by ensuring accurate answers and streamlining drafting tasks.

Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. You will work on challenging real-world computer vision problems, from real-time object detection and tracking on embedded devices to advanced scene understanding and cloud-based inference. This position is for an on-site employee for our Zurich office. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Achter het platform zit een groeiende stroom leerdata. Die moet klanten, de business en de AI-features die we bouwen écht verder helpen. Daar zoeken we een Data Engineer voor die de datalaag bezit. De rol Je komt in een klein datateam binnen Product & Tech en rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering. Je werk bedient twee takken. Business: rapportages voor commerce, management en investeerders. Product: de inzichten die klanten in het platform zien, zoals voortgang en budget. Collega’s bouwen de dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt en meebeweegt met het product. Je werkt dagelijks samen met een businessanalist en een productanalist, die ook met Looker en dbt werkt. Er komt nog een analist bij. Een ervaren data engineer sluit één dag per week aan en een Data Lead staat op de planning. Wat je doet Je bent eigenaar van het Snowflake-platform: rollen en rechten, warehouse sizing en provisioning, tasks en kosten. Je beheert GitHub voor het dataplatform: branches, environments en automatisering met GitHub Actions. Je neemt Databricks, opgezet voor een high-security omgeving, over van een externe partij en bereidt de migratie van Snowflake naar Databricks voor, gepland voor volgend jaar. Je bouwt pipelines die incrementeel, idempotent, getest en gedocumenteerd zijn, en ontsluit bronnen via Fivetran of custom connectors. Je zorgt dat dbt Cloud betrouwbaar draait: afhankelijkheden, scheduling en failure handling. Je bewaakt freshness, volume en schema drift, en zoekt de root cause als iets breekt. Je ruimt de architectuur op, maakt het platform uitbreidbaar en bouwt GDPR-bewust: toegang, retentie en verwijdering zitten in het ontwerp. Je legt het fundament voor metrics waar sales, marketing en product op sturen, in plaats van handmatige Excels. Wie je bent Je hebt 3 tot 6 jaar productie-ervaring als data engineer. Je hebt de valkuilen al eens gezien en levert zonder platformteam achter je een geteste, gemonitor
